title: SharePoint: Lists - Refreshed user experience
description: Microsoft is introducing a refreshed user experience for SharePoint Lists to make common actions easier to find, improve navigation, and provide greater visibility into views and active filters. The refreshed experience includes a reorganized command bar, clearer breadcrumb navigation for lists that use folders, more prominent view selection and creation, visible filter pills, and consolidated view customization options. These updates are intended to make everyday list tasks more intuitive and help users better understand and manage the information displayed in their views.
